notes: Prerequisites M-14-C and M-16-C are mandatory; use their identity/authority contracts.

Schema changes: inspect the existing codegen entrypoint before regeneration; never hand-edit generated types or invent a new codegen command. The listed check-codegen and wire-diff oracles are conditional on the actual affected inputs, never on the allowed write perimeter alone.
Registration perimeter includes existing crate manifests and module owners only for required exports/dependencies; do not change unrelated declarations.

Accepted prerequisites are retained task boundaries: B2 canonical WorkAccepted revision 323, source/archive commit 51c7472e3e435dfe4c0bf601c5f99c61447e05be, and the previously accepted M-14-C/M-16-C identities. Use their existing contracts without replaying historical acceptance or treating aggregate M14/platform/release/wire debt as cleared. C2 owns exact effect/grant semantics; C3 owns receipts; neither is implemented by descriptor discovery.

Wire compatibility overrides any Clients-through-old-route design: register NEW client-capability-request/result/error epoch1 under schemas/client_capability/e1 and distinct operation rust:vibe-orchestrator:client-capabilities. Retain adapter-plan/e1 request/result/error schemas, generated semantic payloads, corpora, legacy3/native e1 shapes/bytes and public AdapterTarget/AdapterPlanHost/AdapterPlanRoute methods. No old-e1 clients variant, extra union arm or payload escape. No MCP/context source writes. Existing OperationEnvelope outer shape is reused unchanged only through registered new-family binding.

Extract only existing root/DocumentAnalysisHost/AnalysisCapture/context and manifest-equality/selected-source join into private adapter_plan/captured_host.rs. New client_capabilities.rs and optional tests child consume that same source/currentness primitive; no second registry/context table or raw World getter. SourceQueryService::prepare_host/selected_doc_instance/captured_manifest_at/revalidate remain source authority. Descriptor-only discovery never calls world::prepare_adapter_sources or skill hydration. Match each selected provider coordinate/root/version/self and captured manifest digest; revalidate before/after; stale/foreign/duplicate entries refuse NoEffects without refresh or grant issuance.

CLI adapter-plan --kind clients branches before legacy target(), AdapterPlanRoute::new and serve into dedicated new-family serve_client_capabilities. Existing Skills/Deploy behavior, public AdapterTarget and legacy serve remain compatible. No top-level command/main/cli/progress registration rewrite, MCP parity or context mutation is required. The same scoped CLI executable/hash before and after isolated selected package addition must expose new qualified client ID/path/key without an intervening rebuild; an unselected directory remains invisible.

Actual authored source perimeter is the existing manifest mechanism typed optional client_request grammar/wire; pure selected extension registry and its exports; agent-projection/client_capabilities.rs and lifecycle deploy/client_capabilities.rs plus their necessary existing registrations/legacy adapters; the exact upper and CLI paths listed; schemas/client_capability/e1/{request,result,error}.jtd.json, formats/REGISTRY.toml and formats/corpora/client-capability/e1/**, wire behaviour/client_capability.rs and required registration/generated output; fixtures/next/adapters/m-08-c1/**. PROP054 changes are additive only, preserving all previous/A2/B1 clauses. Broad outer roots do not authorize unrelated source/schema/wire changes or another engine. PROP044, world/mod.rs and neighboring source owners stay read-only; actual missing accessor needs an exact scope amendment.

Exactly nine extra compatibility paths are authorized ONLY to add required client_request: None to existing MechanismDecl initializers: crates/vibe-lifecycle/src/native/tests.rs, crates/vibe-lifecycle/src/native/mechanism_tests.rs, crates/vibe-lifecycle/src/native/compiler_facts_semantic_tests.rs, crates/vibe-lifecycle/src/mechanism/package/support.rs, crates/vibe-lifecycle/src/mechanism/build/tests.rs, crates/vibe-lifecycle/src/mechanism/build/native_tests.rs, crates/vibe-orchestrator/src/dispatch/native_provider_e2e_tests.rs, crates/vibe-orchestrator/src/dispatch/native_mechanism_tests.rs, crates/vibe-orchestrator/src/dispatch/native_build_package_e2e_tests.rs. No native/E2E behavior changes or broad suites at those sites. Verify actual initializer sites before editing; do not evade the typed field with an unchecked side table.

Conditional existing codegen publication outside vibe-wire is mechanical ONLY at crates/progress-core/src/generated/, vibevm/vibepacks/org.vibevm.ai-native/core-ai-native/v1.1.0/crates/core-ai-native-specmap/src/generated/, vibevm/vibepacks/org.vibevm.doc/web/v1.1.0/site/src/generated/doc-manifest.ts, including incumbent temporary sibling staging paths. No hand-edit, neighboring feature/source/schema change or xtask implementation edit. Record before/after hashes and actual diff; unchanged incidental output stays unchanged. Preserve old adapter-plan e1 hash sets. New-family generation is real V5 impact, but inherited check-codegen index-diff and wire-diff pre-epoch/index debt remain explicit failed/unrun limits, never forced green.

Seven verification groups retain full three steps, two positive/two negative cases and both criteria. V1 strict core/registry; V2 open map/legacy bridges/authority separation; V3 NEW upper consumer and identical CLI binary package addition; V4 new registered map corpus plus old grammar/e1 preservation; V5 actual generation with separate exits; V6 scoped authored Rust edition2024/skip_children and whitespace; V7 one scoped CLI build only when same-subject executable is unavailable. New test modules/cases are TO CREATE and must be bound before compilation; no broad suite, --list fallback, cold target, toolchain download, real HOME/vendor/network, UI or Lean. Fixture setup effects are separate from pure query counters and inventories.

Pure selected registry metadata requests contain qualified open client identity/version, scope/shape, normalized relative destination below symbolic trusted roots, structured member-key segments and closed host operations. Unknown epoch/op/duplicate refuses whole admission before effects. Canonical open map is actually consumed by the new upper service; legacy3/profile readers explicitly reject unrepresentable keys rather than silently dropping them. Descriptor/hash/marker/version never grants process/write/target/principal authority; source strength, implementation, availability and authorization remain distinct.

Expand symbolic roots and member paths to exact resources; check duplicate/ancestor overlap, case aliases and physical containment before grant issuance.
Bind grants to plan/descriptor/operation/resources/root/principal/policy generation; prohibit adapter writes to grant/policy/producer-trust/publication-mode control stores.

Foreign neighboring values and files remain unchanged.

Active MCP launch content is visible in the prepared plan and does not inherit execution approval from a hash.
